tracks.title: An Ending (Ascent) - Remastered 2019
tracks.note: Floating synth layers. A spacious opening for arrivals or the first coffee break.

tracks.title: Weightless Part 1
tracks.note: Slowly shifting electronic textures with a soft pulse. A good foundation for conversation.

tracks.title: Abandon Window
tracks.note: Piano dissolving into electronic atmosphere. A quiet bridge between the human and technical sides of the day.

tracks.title: Endless Falls
tracks.note: Rain, sustained tones, and unhurried movement. Suits a room full of small-group discussions.

tracks.title: 1/1 - Remastered 2004
tracks.note: Long, sparse piano loops from Music for Airports. Useful when you want fewer track changes during a break.

tracks.title: 2/2 - Remastered 2004
tracks.note: Slow synth tones and plenty of space. Another restrained option for longer breaks.

tracks.title: GREEN
tracks.note: From GREEN (1986). Warm FM-synth patterns offer a relaxed backdrop for arrivals and coffee breaks.

tracks.title: FEEL
tracks.note: From GREEN (1986). A gentle electronic melody adds a little movement while keeping the room calm.

tracks.title: Water Copy
tracks.note: From Music for Nine Post Cards (1982). Sparse, repeating keyboard motifs leave space for conversation.

tracks.title: Clouds
tracks.note: From Music for Nine Post Cards (1982). Soft, unhurried keyboard tones suit a quiet pause between sessions.

tracks.title: Time after time
tracks.note: From Surround (1986). An eleven-minute environmental piece offers a continuous backdrop for a longer break.

tracks.title: Something blue
tracks.note: From Surround (1986), written for shared living spaces. Spacious electronic tones make a gentle option for mingling.

tracks.title: Ambre
tracks.note: Intimate, repeating piano phrases. Adds warmth between the more electronic selections.

tracks.title: Small Memory
tracks.note: A short, delicate piano interlude. Works as a gentle change of texture.

tracks.title: Avril 14th
tracks.note: Understated acoustic piano from an electronic music pioneer. A subtle fit with the technology theme.

tracks.title: saman
tracks.note: A brief, spacious piano piece. Keeps the room feeling calm without demanding attention.

tracks.title: The Pearl - 2005 Digital Remaster
tracks.note: Soft piano suspended in ambient processing. An easy match for the quieter tracks.

tracks.title: Late October - 2005 Digital Remaster
tracks.note: Unhurried piano and a hazy electronic backdrop. A warm alternative for the autumn setting.

tracks.title: Alone in Kyoto
tracks.note: Gentle instrumental electronics with a clear melody. Adds some movement while staying relaxed.

tracks.title: Bless This Morning Year
tracks.note: Warm textures and a light beat. Try this for lunch or a busier coffee break.

tracks.title: Adrift
tracks.note: A steady electronic groove with an airy sound. More rhythmic than the calm starter set.

tracks.title: A Walk
tracks.note: Bright synths and a distinct beat. Use sparingly if the room needs a little more energy.
